01 THE POINT OF VIEW

      
Good design has roots.
Great ideas keep growing.
I’m Bonga Bhengu, a South African fashion designer with a love for African identity, denim, construction and the unexpected.
My work has taken me from Durban’s fashion scene to a collection presentation in New York. Today, I’m bringing that same curiosity to AI, visual storytelling and the business of building a brand.

04 MY STORY
A designer’s hands.
A learner’s mindset.
My foundation is fashion. My next chapter is built on the willingness to keep learning.
“
Mindset is Power.
BONGA BHENGU

      

        
THE FOUNDATION
Learning the craft in Durban
Formal training in Fashion Design & Technology at ML Sultan Technikon, followed by a creative practice in collection development, garment construction and contemporary African fashion.

        
THE FASHION JOURNEY
African identity on a world stage
A winning designer in the Africa Designs–M-Net and AngloGold Future Fashion Competition, with an original collection presented in New York. A recipient of the KwaZulu-Natal Wholesaler Gold competition award.

        
THE CREATIVE PRACTICE
Building, creating and sharing
DONLEGEND and designer development connect my creative work with brand building and mentoring emerging talent. African culture, denim and experimental materials remain part of my design language.

        
2023 ONWARDS
A new chapter with AI
I began teaching myself AI in 2023. Through Innovative AI Design, I explore how image and video tools can support fashion, brand storytelling and practical creative work.

      

      
MY PERSONAL MESSAGE
Healing • Learn • Rebuild
A space for hope, faith, growth and the courage to begin again.
01

05 PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
The experience
behind the ideas.
Download professional profile

      
Over 20 years of experience in fashion design, garment production, education and business ownership. I work across the complete garment process: interpreting a brief, sourcing fabric, making patterns, cutting, sewing, costing, planning production and checking quality.
That hands-on experience also shapes how I lead teams, train staff, negotiate with customers and deliver to deadlines. I bring these skills to creative projects and opportunities in production, operations, customer service, training and team supervision.

      
SOUTH AFRICANISIZULU & ENGLISHDURBAN, KWAZULU-NATAL
